name: Sigil Fragment
summary: The Sigil Fragment is one piece of a protective sigil sought in the Arathi Highlands. Tor’gan in Hammerfall can bind the gathered fragments together.

sections.title: Pieces of a Sigil
sections.body: Stromgarde defenders hold fragments of the sigil in the ruins of Stromgarde. Galen, son of Thoras Trollbane, divided the Sigil of Thoradin into eleven pieces and scattered them among the defenders. Tor’gan, a troll shaman in Hammerfall, can bind the gathered pieces back into the complete sigil.

faq.answer: A Sigil Fragment is one piece of the Sigil of Thoradin, which Galen divided into eleven parts.
Stromgarde defenders in the Arathi Highlands hold the fragments.

faq.q: Who can put the sigil back together?
faq.answer: Tor’gan, the troll shaman in Hammerfall, can bind the fragments into the complete Sigil of Thoradin.

faq.q: Why was the sigil broken apart?
faq.answer: Galen, son of Thoras Trollbane, divided the Sigil of Thoradin into eleven pieces and scattered them among Stromgarde defenders.

angles.text: As a shaman, you may recognize Tor’gan’s role: the troll shaman can bind the fragments into a whole sigil.
